Header.Description: Minimal renderer-ready product terms XML for the Smart Product Framework demo. The negotiated economic values are resolved from the deployed SimpleBond contract.

Lifecycle.Requested: The investor has requested the product and may amend notional or maturity while the trade is still Requested.
Lifecycle.Incepted: The product provider has accepted the current terms and frozen the agreed terms hash.
Lifecycle.Active: The investor has confirmed the incepted terms and the trade is active.
